_comment: Official Espressif Wi-Fi throughput figures. REFERENCE ONLY - these are NOT pass/fail limits; the harness never fails a board for being below them (they need a shielded box and a router peer).
_conditions: Single stream, iperf example built with examples/wifi/iperf/sdkconfig.defaults.<chip>. 'air' = best over-the-air result in Espressif's lab; 'shield' = shielded box using an ASUS RT-N66U router. Units: Mbit/s.
_source: ESP-IDF docs, 'Wi-Fi Performance and Power Save', per-target page: https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/en/v6.0/<chip>/api-guides/wifi-driver/wifi-performance-and-power-save.html
_idf_note: The tables are stamped with the IDF commit the measurement was made on, which is NOT the IDF version you build with. ESP32/S2/S3/C3 figures are from commit 15575346 (2021-04-21); the ESP32-C6 figures are from 7ff0a07d (2024-12-14).

esp32c2.name: ESP32-C2
esp32c2.note: Espressif does not publish a throughput table for this chip in the ESP-IDF docs.

esp32c5.name: ESP32-C5
esp32c5.note: No throughput table captured yet. Same docs URL pattern with 'esp32c5'.
